title: Introducing Spyglass
summary: We are excited to officially launch Spyglass, our powerful new tool designed to bring enhanced capabilities directly to you.

title: Enhanced File Management in Your Editor
summary: Take complete control of your content with our redesigned editor, offering seamless management of all embedded files and flexible display options for a tailored writing experience.

title: Introducing Our Public Product Roadmap
summary: Discover our exciting new public product roadmap, offering a transparent view into recently completed features, upcoming updates, and future plans.

title: Effortless Checkboxes
summary: Enjoy a seamless experience with our newly redesigned checkboxes, now bigger, more responsive, and effortlessly draggable for enhanced productivity.

title: Elevated Collaboration Experience
summary: Enjoy a significantly upgraded collaboration experience that brings effortless teamwork and greater awareness when working with others.

title: Enhanced Shared Item Discovery
summary: We've made it easier than ever to discover and utilize all shared items, empowering seamless collaboration with your network.

title: Experience Noeko in Your Language
summary: We're thrilled to announce that Noeko now supports a wide array of international languages, creating a truly global and inclusive experience for everyone.

title: Noeko Goes Open Source
summary: Noeko is now open source, empowering our community with unprecedented control, transparency, and the opportunity for direct involvement in shaping its future.

title: Enhanced Constellation View
summary: Explore your knowledge base like never before with an upgraded Constellation View, offering dynamic filtering by tags and time, alongside seamless sharing functionalities to discover connections with friends.

title: Discover and Curate Your Knowledge with Enhanced Search
summary: Empower your discovery with advanced filtering and sorting capabilities, allowing you to easily narrow down your knowledge and save specific insights as personalized collections.

title: Dynamic Note Previews and Enhanced Interactions
summary: Experience a more intuitive and visually engaging way to organize your thoughts with flexible new content displays that offer richer previews and enhanced interactivity for your connected notes.

title: Unlock Noeko: Self-Hosting and Powerful Paid Plans
summary: We're launching Noeko's full potential, providing secure self-hosting capabilities alongside flexible paid plans to empower every user.

title: Vibrant New Themes & Polished Classics
summary: Discover a collection of beautifully designed new themes and enjoy significant improvements to our existing favorites, allowing you to perfectly personalize your workspace with style and clarity.

title: Perfectly Timed Greetings
summary: Enjoy a more personalized experience with perfectly timed greetings on your homepage, ensuring the app always reflects the right part of your day.

title: Streamlined Tag Management
summary: Effortlessly remove tags and perform other essential actions on multiple items directly from your tag views, significantly enhancing your organization and productivity.

title: Unlock More Content Sources
summary: Effortlessly integrate a wider variety of content, including YouTube videos, websites, and text, to centralize all your valuable information and streamline your research.
